what: the lenses built into ocoeco are not things: one cannot stand on a lens and look around - what it reads, what places it, what asks of its shapes - as on anything else; only the lens of language sees them, as rows of its own
an item's next step is typed, and goes stale as a typed state did: a lens that makes lenses said its next was a trial made two days before, at the head of a line of halting five long

a star's idea - why it exists, in its own words, 95 rows across the stars - is pointed at by nothing, and a walk arrives at the one line its mark says instead: what a star is for is said twice, and the fuller saying is not reached

all 20 principles, all 10 architectures and 35 of 39 practices are pointed at by nothing: the guidelines said to govern how things are made are followed, or not, without one decision saying which it follows
